build: web staging build (VITE_SOCIAL, VITE_WEB_SQLITE, VITE_AUTH_PASSWORD) – Chromium 390×844 ×2, not phones

steps.step: both open the app (two separate browsers) and finish the short onboarding
both sign in with their own test account (hosted staging)
A opens "לומדים יחד": what the partner will see, what not, backup from now
A agrees and shares (display name, backup only from now)
B opens "לומדים יחד" and agrees to share
B types the code: who invites, the metric, the period, the comparison – before joining
B agrees to the terms and joins
A sees B in the challenge (0 of 3 each)
A reads today's halacha in the app – reading records nothing
A records "למדתי" on purpose – the message names it, with undo
B refreshes: A at 1 of 3 (sent from A's SQLite, confirmed by the server)
B cheers A (יישר כוח) – once a day
A undoes the entry from Home; B sees A back at 0
A records again, sees the cheer from B
(demo) the challenge's dates moved back 8 days on the server: 201
after it closes: the result by the agreed rule, the goal, and another round
